name: Alphabet Inc.
research_rationale: Quality and FY2025 cash still fit the buy screen, but surging AI capex, weak TTM FCF and spend headlines modestly weaken GARP; regulatory and litigation overhangs are unchanged in the files.

weekly_updates.summary:
News since the October memo highlights heavy AI/datacentre spend (including Anthropic-linked headlines), post-earnings share weakness near $300, and Berkshire’s reported Q3 trim.
Yahoo data still shows TTM FCF ~$19.7bn with negative FCF in Q2–Q3 2026 as capex accelerated; SEC FY2025 FCF ~$73bn in sources is unchanged.
No new company filings in this batch; spend and return timing remain unresolved.
